reason: A DeepSeek Harness companion suite centered on persistent local memory, user-managed personas, roleplay continuity, and delegated agent workflows, with local settings and constrained web and workspace file tools.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先陪伴插件套件，用于管理角色人格、跨会话长期记忆、角色扮演体验和受控的任务委派。
summaries.en: A local-first DeepSeek Harness companion suite for managing personas, cross-session memory, roleplay continuity, and controlled task delegation.

capabilities: stores and retrieves persistent local memories
manages user-defined personas and roleplay settings
reads web pages through read-only web tools
reads files within the current session workspace
delegates coding, research, and review tasks to child agents
modifies local persona, memory, and installation state after owner confirmation
